metaTitle: Custom Russell Athletic Pullovers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Russell Athletic pullovers with your logo. Durable, comfortable fleece for teams and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Russell Athletic pullovers combine classic fleece warmth with rugged durability, making them a trusted choice for corporate teams, safety crews, and event staff. The Russell Outdoors Basin Jacket, for example, offers a water-resistant shell and zip-off sleeves, ideal for outdoor work or promotional giveaways. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered emblems for a professional finish that stands up to repeated wear. Choose from charcoal, navy, black, and other versatile colors.
heroAltText: Custom Russell Athletic pullovers with embroidered logo, charcoal fleece, team apparel for bulk orders
